facts.fact: BCEAO says Guinea-Bissau has 5 institutions authorised on its regional PI-SPI platform at 31 July 2026.
BCEAO runs the PI-SPI interoperable instant-payment platform, on which Guinea-Bissau has 5 authorised institutions.
